notes: New 'Your subscriptions' section on Settings → Licensing — see what you're paying for, how often (monthly / yearly), how much, and when each renews. One section per active or recently-cancelled subscription

In-portal cancel — 'Cancel at period end' button per subscription, with a confirmation dialog and an Undo button while the cancellation is pending. No more redirect to Stripe for the common cancel flow
Setup note: STRIPE_RESTRICTED_KEY needs subscriptions:write added (covers read too). Without it, the new section will show 'Couldn't load subscriptions'
